Soft pieces

Baby bolognese

Bababolognai

8 months+ Adjusted 40 min 6 portions

Serve a small mashed or finely chopped bowl. Freeze extra sauce in small pots and thaw it in the fridge.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g lean beef mince
  • 1 medium carrot (grated)
  • 1 small zucchini (grated)
  • 200 g ripe tomatoes (chopped)
  • 1 small onion (finely chopped)
  • 4 leaves basil (chopped)
  • 100 g small pasta (dry weight, cooked very soft)
  • 100 ml water (plain, no stock cube)
  • 1 tsp olive oil

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Soften the onion in the oil, then add the mince and cook until no pink remains.
  2. Stir in the carrot, zucchini, tomato, and water, and do not add a stock cube.
  3. Simmer until the vegetables are soft and the sauce is thick, about 20 minutes.
  4. Boil the pasta in unsalted water until very soft, then drain it.
  5. Chop or mash the sauce with the pasta, and cool extra portions quickly.

Adjusted

This is a sound idea once the salt is gone, but the usual sauce is made with a salted stock cube. That salt is the problem, not the beef, vegetables, or soft pasta.

Simmer the mince and vegetables in unsalted tomato and water, with no stock cube. Mash or chop the pasta and sauce for the baby, and freeze the extra.
